correctness.rationale: Reconstructed spectral projectors for A(G)⊗J_m, including the merged zero projector E_0⊗P+I⊗Q. Expanded their Hadamard squares: Mhat(B)=Mhat(G)⊗J_m/m²+(2/m)diag(E_0,uu)⊗Q+I⊗[(m−2)I/m+J_m/m²]. The constant-fibre and fibre-difference invariant spaces have dimensions n and n(m−1), exhaust the vertex space and yield the claimed eigenvalues. Positivity follows from the Schur product theorem and E_0 being a projector; invertible base A gives equality. Independent SymPy exact checks from directly diagonalized blow-up projectors reproduced K2 m=2 rank2, K2 m=3 rank6, P3 m=2 rank5, isolated vertex m=3 rank3; finite checks corroborate but do not prove unrestricted scope.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete all-base/all-m spectral classification of long-time quantum transport under graph vertex replication. The universal positive-definite gap for m≥3 and the precise m=2 rank/kernel transition explain a sharp structural change; nullity links to the independently motivated strong-cospectral clone condition. It is not merely a low-order table.

final_claim: For every finite simple base graph G and independent-fibre multiplicity m≥2, the adjacency quantum-walk Cesàro average mixing matrix of B_m(G) has the exact two-sector spectrum: (m−1+λ_i(Mhat(G)))/m and (m−2+2(E_0)_{uu})/m each with multiplicity m−1. Rank is n+number of positive diagonal zero-projector entries when m=2, and nm when m≥3; for m≥3 the universal spectral lower bound (m−2)/m is sharp.
limitations: Equal independent-fibre sizes and ordinary adjacency-Hamiltonian Cesàro average only; no Laplacian, unequal-fibre, instantaneous or sampled-time claims.
No independent external certificate, mechanized proof, or implied novelty for individual projector lemmas.
